description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - The Societies Ordinance, Society Know as Desheeya Saha Videsheeya Buddha Charika Sanvidayakayange Sangamaya Y.M.B.A. Building, Colombo 08 as a purpose to which the Powers & Facilities of that Ordinance Ought to be extended.
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal framework) to authorize a society's purpose and grant a legal exemption from specific ordinance provisions. It deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure categories.
